text:
Anjali: Quick follow-up from the reliability segment — dropping RCA link and action items here so we can track post-all-hands. pls react if you're taking an item :pray:

Mike: thanks! link to RCA: https://internal.redwood.com/rcas/2026-03-18-ingress-throttle — it's the doc quoted in the talk.

Carla: reading now. can we get the owner list and due dates? want to sync with SRE sprint planning.

Anjali: yes — summarized below. i'll also add to the incident board.

ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-18 (INGRESS_THROTTLE) recorded. Summary: transient router overload -> fallback cascade -> increased tail latencies.

Anjali: Action 1 — router rate-limiter tuning + circuit-breaker defaults, owner: Mike, due: 2026-03-25.

Mike: taking Action 1. i'll open a PR for config changes and run a canary in staging first. ETA for PR: EOD tomorrow.

Anjali: Action 2 — add prefix-level KV cache warmup for embeddings workloads, owner: Carla, due: 2026-04-01.

Carla: taking Action 2. will coordinate with eng-runtime to add a small warmup job. can folks post sample traffic patterns?

Ryan: we have a traffic sample in the telemetry bucket: s3://redwood-telemetry/samples/embeddings/peak-feb.parquet. Carla, i'll attach a short query to extract distributions.

Leah: Action 3 — improve alert thresholds & runbook clarity (pager thresholds and playbook), owner: Leah, due: 2026-03-30. i'll start a brief doc and ask SRE for review.

Dave: Action 4 — autoscale policy review for Dedicated pools (burst vs steady), owner: Dave, due: 2026-04-08. i'll add a simulation job to test scale-in delays.

Anjali: small ops note: temporary fallback mapping was disabled by rollout. we should add a runtime flag to prevent accidental disable. owner: Mike, include in PR.

Mike: noted. including runtime flag + tests.

Carla: quick troubleshooting tip from the incident — to pull router logs for the window use:
```
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=router --since=2h | grep "throttle" -C2
```
will attach the exact grep we used to the RCA.

Ryan: cc @Leah @Dave — i pushed a small telemetry query to the RCA doc that extracts 95/99 latencies by route. link: https://internal.redwood.com/rcas/2026-03-18-ingress-throttle#telemetry

Leah: can we add an action to run the alert threshold run for the next 2 weeks and report weekly? owner: Leah, subtask on the runbook.

Anjali: yes, add as Action 3.1 — weekly alert review for 2 weeks, owner Leah, due: 2026-04-13.

Mike: quick question for product folks — do we want stricter soft-limits for low-tier customers to avoid noisy neighbors, or do we prefer adaptive routing? @Carla product input appreciated.

Carla: product preference: adaptive routing preferred, but we should pilot stricter soft-limits on a tiny cohort first. i'll work with Mike on cohort definition.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-19-14:32 completed to staging by @Mike — no errors reported.

Anjali: next steps: i'm creating an incident board card per action and will tag owners. please update card when PRs/tasks are opened. i'll run a 15min sync next Tue to close blockers.

Mike: i'll post the PR link when ready (will ping here).

Carla: adding the warmup job plan to the RCA doc now.

Leah: starting runbook edits today.

Dave: starting scale sims tomorrow.

Anjali: thanks everyone. if you can't meet a due date, please update the card ASAP so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
